'''Trig Kilwallen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] living on [[G'rho]]. He was the brother of [[Ydra Kilwallen Sibwarra]], uncle of [[Dev Sibwarra]] and husband to fellow [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Seni Kilwallen|Seni]]. Trig was a member of the [[G'rho Defense Force]] and flew a [[Conjo fighter]].
